name: chart-radar
title: Radar Chart
description: A row of dark cards, each holding a spider plot over six months with a spoke or ring grid, a pale filled area and month labels around the rim. Some cards add a two-item legend.
use: Comparing a few entities across the same fixed set of six to eight categories where the overall shape matters.
avoid: Many categories or very small cards: rim labels crowd and the filled areas become hard to tell apart.
a11y: Values are reachable only by mouse hover; there is no keyboard focus, table fallback or spoken description of the series. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Three dark rounded cards sit in a row, each with a small variant title and a caption line. A faint grey web of spokes or concentric rings sits over a pale filled six-point shape, with month labels around the edge. A footer pairs an up-trend arrow with a percentage and a date range.
behaves: The plots do not move. Hovering a filled shape raises a small dark tooltip with the series label and its value for that month; otherwise the cards stay still.
customise: Each variant hardcodes its data, title and footer copy, so those need a source edit; colours can be changed through the shared chart CSS variables.
weight: light: A handful of SVG polygons per card with no per-frame loop; only hover redraws.
demo: Three variant titles, the caption Showing total visitors for the last 6 months, and a Trending up footer.
issues: Small grey month labels and footer copy sit at low contrast on the dark card.
polishWhy: Competent default chart styling; small grey text and a crowded three-up demo keep it ordinary.
